summary: {organizer} follows the approach to the outdoor audience area and finds that the firm path gives way to grass.
realLife: At the Los Banos Fairgrounds outdoor stage, the survey found an unsuitable grass approach and no designated wheelchair seating areas.
gates: A public event uses an outdoor stage where the approach or seating layout has failed an access survey.
inGame: needs: the outdoor event layout, path surface and placement of wheelchair seats.

turns.what: The organizer revises the seating plan.
turns.pulledBy: Crews improve the approach but omit spaces among the seats.
turns.writesBack: The access check still lists seating.

turns.what: Staff trace the route to its new position.
turns.writesBack: The event map records the new approach.
